text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
choice_data_list: Were you not able to get much rest?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Actually, yesterday I got together with the girls
from the dorm and stayed up late chatting.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"That was so fun~. It was full of interesting stories,
I was thrilled the whole time!"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: "I'd love to chat more today, but... I think I'm getting... just a little bit sleepy..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Clearly lacking sleep, Fine Motion
seemed drowsy the entire day.
